text: {"memo": "Apple Inc. (AAPL) concluded its fiscal year 2024 with continued revenue resilience amid a challenging macro environment, reporting $394.3 billion in revenue, a modest 3% year-over-year increase from $383.3 billion in FY2023. The growth was primarily driven by strength in services and wearables, which partially offset a flattish performance in iPhone sales. Earnings per share rose to $6.12 in FY2024, up from $5.89 in FY2023, reflecting disciplined cost management and higher-margin services growth. Net income totaled $99.8 billion in FY2024, up from $97.0 billion the prior year. Gross margin remained robust at 44.5%, supported by a favorable product mix and pricing power, compared to 43.8% in FY2023. Operating cash flow reached $104.2 billion in FY2024, consistent with prior trends, enabling $90 billion in shareholder returns through dividends and buybacks. The installed base of active Apple devices surpassed 2.2 billion globally by the end of 2024, up from 2.0 billion in 2023, underpinning long-term services potential. In FY2022, Apple reported $394.3 billion in revenue as well, making FY2024 a return to peak revenue levels after a slight dip in FY2023 due to supply chain constraints and foreign exchange headwinds. Despite increased regulatory scrutiny in the U.S. and Europe, Apple maintained its ecosystem advantage and expanded its generative AI integration across devices in 2024. The company remains well-positioned with strong free cash flow generation and a diversified revenue base. Apple stock appears fairly valued, balancing solid execution against limited near-term catalysts."}
